faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Short answers about the membership, your tools and our services. If your question is not here, write to us.

items.question: What does the membership include?
items.answer: The GENESIS modules of your tier for your team, with documentation, software updates and product support. It is software access, not a chip design delivered on your behalf.

items.question: How is GENESIS licensed and priced?
items.answer: Per user. Your tier, the number of users and the term are set in your offer, together with the price, the update policy and the support terms.

items.question: Which tools does GENESIS work with?
items.answer: Cadence Virtuoso and Spectre for circuit simulation, and your EM solver for passive structures. Other tools and in-house flows can be connected as a separate integration project.

items.question: Where does GENESIS run, and where does our data stay?
items.answer: GENESIS runs on your own Linux server, next to your Cadence tools and licenses, and your engineers use it in the browser. Where your data stays and who can access it is agreed for your setup; hosting can be arranged separately.

items.question: What do we need to provide?
items.answer: Compatible CAD and solver licenses, authorized PDK access and device models, and compute and storage in your environment. These stay separate from the GENESIS membership.

items.question: What is not included in the membership?
items.answer: Custom tool integration, deployment and training, managed compute or EM resources, circuit design consulting and fabrication. Each is scoped separately, so you know what every engagement covers.

items.question: Can you help us take a design to silicon?
items.answer: Yes, as a separate service: prototype planning, fabrication preparation and measurement support. Fabrication, packaging and lab access are scoped for each project.

items.question: What support do we get?
items.answer: Documentation, access to software releases and product support for your supported environment. Support channels, availability and onboarding are agreed in your membership.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: With a free demo session. Then we agree your tier, users and toolchain, and review compatibility and installation requirements while you arrange the tool licenses, PDK access and infrastructure.

story.headline: How GENESIS started.
story.intro: GENESIS grew out of our own work: RFIC research on one side, building AI products on the other.
paragraphs: In RF design, a new idea often takes shape quickly. The time goes into everything around it: preparing the next simulation, comparing it with the last run, checking what the change does to the layout, and then doing it all again.

We kept asking why that loop still had to be run by hand. GENESIS is our answer: the engineer sets the goal and makes the decisions, and GENESIS carries the repetitive work between the tools, taking what each design taught us into the next one.
